title: The Vedas
original: Sanskrit, in Devanagari with the vedic accents
status: Partly here. The Rigveda is on the shelves, and it opens the Vedic corpus without closing it: the Yajur, Sama and Atharva samhitas and the Upanishads all stand behind it, and the Hinduism dive's canon row covers more than this room yet holds.
